test_title: PYST 164: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 09 Feb, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All cats are dogs.

Some dogs are elephants

All elephants are camels.

**Conclusions:**

I. All cats are elephants.

II. Some cats are elephants.

III. Some elephants are dogs

IV. Some camels are dogs.
solution:
Given Statements:

All cats are dogs.

Some dogs are elephants

All elephants are camels.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f97bdb39763f91373df97444b0bdd6ea0150e95ae2a2f520e4d77274712a136c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All cats are elephants - False (Because, No definite relation given between cats and elephant, so it can be possible only).

II. Some cats are elephants - False (Because, No definite relation given between cats and elephant, so it can be possible only).

III. Some elephants are dogs - True (Because, Some dogs are elephants, it means Some elephants are dogs)

IV. Some camels are dogs - True (Because, Those part of camel that is elephant will also dogs)

So, Conclusion III and IV follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
